questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT an Essential Difficulty according to the article `No Silver Bullet`?
Which of these statements about Accidental Difficulties is FALSE?
options: A) They are the problems that arise during the effort of building software.
B) They come from the tools, languages, techniques and processes we use.
C) Tools succeeded precisely because they attacked these accidental difficulties.
D) Further tooling improvements will continue to deliver the same order-of-magnitude gains.

questions.prompt: What is the main point of `No Silver Bullet`?
options: A) The complexity of software will continue be reduced to almost nothing.
B) Human beings are a much bigger problem in SwE than the sofware itself.
C) No technique or technology will produce an order-of-magnitude improvement in software productivity.
D) If you pick the right SDLC, a near perfect product can be produced.
